note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. Conscription was being phased out between 1997 and 2001 (Wikipedia: Conscription in France), so universal_conscription is kept for the start date. Energy: nuclear power supplied most of France's electricity, so nuclear_expansion stands for a nuclear-centred policy rather than new construction. Religion and state: laicite (separation of churches and state). Healthcare: statutory sickness insurance (Securite sociale).
